blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Objectives: To measure whether a locally hosted large language model (LLM), stacked with deterministic and clinical named-entity recognition (NER) detectors, finds more protected health information (PHI) than open tools, and at what precision.
  Materials and Methods: DeidSharp, an open-source .NET toolkit, combines the findings of pluggable detectors (patterns, a clinical NER model, a local 26B mixture-of-experts LLM) and fails closed on any detector error. Configurations fixed on tuning halves were compared, under a prespecified protocol, with deid, Philter, the Stanford/Penn de-identifier, OpenAI Privacy Filter and GLiNER on reporting halves of PhysioNet's nursing notes (889 spans) and semi-synthetic MIMIC-IV-Note discharge summaries (29,023 spans), and on synthetic ASQ-PHI queries, with paired patient-level bootstrap intervals.
  Results: In the nursing notes, against Stanford/Penn, the recall-first stack found 98.9% of PHI (+2.8, 95% CI 1.4 to 4.4) at 9.3 points lower precision; the precision-first stack, without NER, found 96.5%, matching Stanford/Penn, at 19.6 points higher precision (83.2%). In the discharge summaries, both stacks led Stanford/Penn by more than 20 points (recall-first 95.3%, +21.5, 20.5 to 22.4), almost entirely on generated untyped names; on typed labels all three exceeded 99%. All four prespecified comparisons held. No configuration beat deid significantly on its home corpus; Philter found more discharge-summary spans than the recall-first stack at 23 points lower precision.
  Discussion: The LLM was the main detector and NER added place names; asked to verify its own findings, the LLM discarded a quarter of true PHI.
  Conclusion: A local LLM layered with deterministic detectors offers recall-first and precision-first operating points without sending text off-site.
blocks.zh:
目标: 为了衡量当地托管的大型语言模型(LLM)是否配有决定性的和临床的命名实体识别(NER)探测器,发现了比开放式工具更受保护的健康信息(PHI),以及何种精度.
材料与方法:DeidSharp,开源. NET工具包,结合了可插接探测器(patters,一种临床NER模型,一种本地的26B型专家混合LLM)的发现,并因任何探测器出错而失效. 根据预先规定的协议,将固定在调制分身上的配置与Deid、Philter、Stanford/Penn去识别器、OpenAI隐私过滤器和GLinER进行比较,以报告PhysioNet的护理笔记(889个跨度)和半合成MIIC-IV-Note排放摘要(29,023个跨度),以及合成ASQ-PHI查询,并配对病人级的靴子间隔。
结果: 在护理笔记中,针对斯坦福/彭恩,召回第一堆在9.3分更低的精度上发现了98.9%的PHI (+2.8,95% CI 1.4至4.4);精度第一堆在没有NER的情况下,发现了96.5%,与斯坦福/彭恩相匹配,在19.6分更高的精度上(83.2%). 在放出简况中,两堆都使斯坦福/平分超过20分(召回前95.3%,+21.5,20.5至22.4),几乎完全依靠生成的无型名;打入的标签上,全部3分都超过了99%. 所有四个预先规定的比较都进行了。 其家用装置上没有显著的配置跳动;菲尔特发现排出-总结跨度比23分更低精度的回放-第一堆要多.
讨论: LLM是主要的探测器,NER增加了地名;为了验证自己的发现,LLM抛弃了四分之一真实的PHI.
结论: 本地LLM分层有确定探测器,提供回溯第一和精度第一的操作点,而不向外发送文本.

blocks.en: Lay summary
blocks.zh: 内容摘要

blocks.en: Doctors’ and nurses’ notes contain names, dates, places and numbers that identify patients. Before notes can be shared for research, those details must be removed, and doing it by hand does not scale. This work presents a free, open-source tool that combines several automatic methods: fixed rules for numbers and dates, a model trained on clinical notes, and a general-purpose language model that runs on one graphics card inside the hospital, so no text leaves the site. If any part of the tool fails, it returns nothing rather than a partly cleaned note. The test plan was fixed in advance, and the tool was tested on two collections of hospital notes whose identifiers had been replaced with realistic fakes, and on a public set of synthetic queries. With the language model, the tool found 94% to 99% of the identifying details: as many as or more than an openly available clinical model, and as many as an older rule-based tool on that tool’s own notes. Finding more identifiers usually meant removing more ordinary text as well. All code and results are public, so others can repeat the measurements.
blocks.zh: 医生和护士的笔记中包含识别病人的姓名、日期、地点和号码。 在为研究而分享注释之前,必须去掉这些细节,而用手进行则不会达到规模. 这部作品呈现出一种自由,开源的工具,结合了几种自动方法:数字和日期的固定规则,临床笔记训练的模型,以及医院内运行在一张图形卡上的通用语言模型,所以没有文本离开现场. 如果工具的任何部分失败, 它只返回部分清理的字条。 测试计划提前确定,该工具在两组医院笔记上进行了测试,其标识被取而代之的是现实的假冒,以及一套公开的合成查询. 有了语言模型,该工具发现了94%到99%的识别细节:有多达或超过公开的临床模型,也有多达更古老的基于规则的工具在工具本身的笔记上. 寻找更多的标识符通常也意味着去除更普通的文本. 所有代码和结果都是公开的,所以其他人可以重复测量.

blocks.en: 1 Background and significance
blocks.zh: 1 背景和意义

blocks.en: Free-text clinical notes hold much of the information in an electronic health record, and sharing them for research or for training models requires removing the identifiers that HIPAA’s Safe Harbor method lists, or an equivalent standard [ 1 ] . Manual de-identification does not scale, so automated systems have been studied for two decades: rule- and dictionary-based tools such as deid [ 2 ] and Philter [ 3 ] , shared tasks that standardized evaluation [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] , and neural models trained on annotated notes [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] . Surveys note that results depend strongly on the corpus and on how matches are counted [ 10 , 11 ] .
blocks.zh: Free-text临床笔记保存着电子健康记录中的大部分信息,为了研究或培训模型而共享这些信息,需要移除HIPAA安全港方法所列出的识别符,或者一个等同的标准[1]. 人工去识别不规模化,因此20年来对自动化系统进行了研究:基于规则和词典的工具,如deid [2]和Philter [3],共同的任务,标准化评价[4,5,6],以及神经模型接受附加说明[7,8,9]的培训. 调查指出,结果在很大程度上取决于病历和如何计算匹配[10、11]。

blocks.en: Two problems persist. First, trained models generalize unevenly: one transformer trained on i2b2 found 39% of the names in PhysioNet’s nursing notes, where dictionary tools found 97% [ 12 ] , and authors of trained de-identifiers advise local validation before use [ 9 ] . Second, the strongest general language models are hosted services, and sending notes to them is often barred by data use agreements and institutional policy [ 13 ] .
blocks.zh: 两个问题依然存在。 首先,训练有素的模型概括不均:一个训练有素的i2b2变压器在PhysioNet的护理笔记中发现了39%的名称,其中词典工具发现97%[12],而训练有素的去识别器的作者在使用[9]之前建议进行本地验证. 第二,最强通用语模式是主机服务,向它们发送说明往往受到数据使用协议和机构政策的禁止[13].

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) have been applied to de-identification through hosted APIs [ 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 , 18 ] , as local models used directly [ 19 ] or fine-tuned on annotated or synthetic notes [ 20 , 21 ] , as teachers for smaller models [ 22 ] , and in an open on-premises engine with keyed surrogates and an LLM-distilled recognizer [ 23 ] . Closest to this work, Zhou et al. paired the RoBERTa model used here with a local LLM that verifies and expands its spans [ 24 ] , and MedDeID compared open de-identifiers, including a local LLM, with one scorer on the synthetic ASQ-PHI benchmark [ 25 , 26 ] . Gold standards themselves miss PHI [ 16 ] , which has prompted evaluation without gold labels [ 27 ] . Few studies compare rule-based tools, trained models and LLM layers with one scorer on the same held-out clinical notes, with paired uncertainty and claims stated before measuring, or report the configurations that failed.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)通过托管的API[14,15,16,17,18]应用去识别,作为本地模型直接使用[19]或微调于注解或合成音符上[20,21],作为较小模型的教师[22],在开放的premides引擎上使用有键取代词和LLM-distilled识别器[23]. 与本作最相近相周等. 将这里使用的RoBERTa模型与本地LLM相配,该LLM验证并扩展了它的跨度[24],而MedDeID比较了开放的去识别器,包括本地LLM,在合成的ASQ-PHI基准上有一个分分符 [25,26]. 黄金标准本身就怀念PHI [16],这引发了没有黄金标签的评价 [27]. 很少有研究将基于规则的工具,训练有素的模型和LLM层与同一被搁置的临床笔记上的1个计分器相提并论,在测量前有对偶的不确定性和陈述,或者报告失败的配置.

blocks.en: 2 Objective
blocks.zh: 2 目标

blocks.en: This study asks whether a locally hosted LLM, stacked with deterministic detectors and a clinical NER model, finds more PHI than open tools, and what it costs in precision and in clinical text removed. Its contributions are an open-source, fail-closed toolkit built around that layering; an evaluation against five open baselines with one scorer and paired intervals, under a protocol specified before the final run; a semi-synthetic discharge-summary corpus any credentialed user can rebuild from MIMIC-IV-Note; and a log of every development measurement, including failed designs.
blocks.zh: 本研究询问,当地托管的LLM,堆放着确定性探测器和临床NER模型,是否发现比开放式工具更多的PHI,在精确度和临床文本被去除方面成本多少. 其贡献是:围绕该分层构建的开放源码、故障闭塞工具包;根据最后运行前指定的协议,对5个有1分分数和配对间隔的开阔基线进行评价;任何认证用户都可以从MIMIC-IV-Note中重建的半合成放电总库;以及每个开发计量的日志,包括失败的设计。

blocks.en: 3 Materials and methods
blocks.zh: 3 材料和方法

blocks.en: 3.1 The toolkit
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 工具包

blocks.en: DeidSharp is a set of MIT-licensed .NET 10 libraries [ 28 ] . Besides Safe Harbor transforms for structured data and FHIR R4 resources [ 29 ] and keyed pseudonyms, it de-identifies free text with a stack of detectors run in parallel (Figure 1 ). Detectors return spans and categories, never the covered text, so logs and errors never quote PHI. The union of all spans is replaced (recall first); if any detector fails, the run fails rather than reading the failure as “nothing found.” A deterministic leak guard then refuses output in which a known identifier survived. This study evaluates detection only: the corpora supply no structured record, so neither the known-identifier detector nor the leak guard was exercised.
blocks.zh: DeidSharp是一套麻省理工学院颁发的.NET 10库[28]. 除了安全港变换结构化数据和FHIR R4资源[29]和密钥化假名外,它还用平行运行的一叠探测器来去识别自由文本(图一. 探测器返回跨度和类别,从不覆盖文字,所以日志和错误从不引用PHI. 所有跨度的结合被替换(首先召回);如果任何探测器失败,运行失败而不是将失败读作“没有找到 ” 。 确定性的漏出后,拒绝输出一个已知识别符。 这项研究只评价了检测:蝎子没有提供结构化的记录,所以已知的识别器探测器和漏出后卫都没有行使.

blocks.en: Figure 1: DeidSharp’s free-text pipeline. Detectors return positions and categories only. The stack replaces every span any detector reports; the optional second opinion may drop only spans from the clinical NER model that are not locations or organizations. The leak guard uses the deterministic detectors only and was not exercised in this evaluation.
blocks.zh: 图1:DeidSharp的自由文本管道。 探测器只返回位置和类别。 堆栈可以替换任何探测器的全长报告;可选的第二点意见只能从临床NER模型中缩小,而NER模型不是位置或组织. 漏出后卫只使用定型探测器,在这次评价中并未被行使.

blocks.en: The known-identifier detector matches the names, dates and numbers the structured record already holds (none here, so this study’s numbers are a floor for use with a record). The pattern detector holds rules for shaped identifiers (dates, phones, record numbers, emails, URLs and others, with checksums where they exist). The gazetteer matches US Census name and place lists, with stop lists to limit false matches. The clinical NER detector calls a Presidio analyzer [ 30 ] running the obi/deid_roberta_i2b2 RoBERTa model, trained on the i2b2 2014 corpus [ 31 ] , in a local container. Presidio’s general spaCy NER and its URL and US-license recognizers were disabled: on the nursing notes’ tuning half they produced most of the false positives for about 2 points of recall (Results).

blocks.en: The LLM detector sends text in chunks of 2,000 characters overlapping by 200 to a local model through Microsoft.Extensions.AI’s chat-client abstraction, here served by Ollama [ 32 ] , at temperature 0 with thinking disabled and a JSON schema that constrains the answer to a list of {text, type} items. Each listed text is located in the note wherever it occurs as whole words; text the model invented or reworded is dropped. An answer cut off at the output limit is requested again in halves and fails closed if it still cannot fit. Rule filters drop what Safe Harbor permits keeping, whatever type the model assigned: ages under 90, a year, time or weekday alone, and identifiers of three digits or fewer. The same age rule wraps every stack, since NER models also tag every age. The prompt holds instructions and forty short fictional notes with their answers (about 5,000 tokens; twelve notes contain no PHI); an AI assistant wrote them from fictional examples of the tuning half’s misses, never from corpus text; the model’s context window was raised to 8,192 tokens so the prompt is never truncated. The model of record is Gemma 4 26B-A4B [ 33 ] , a mixture of experts with about 4B active parameters, in Ollama’s default 4-bit quantization. The prompts are in the repository.

AI的聊天客户抽象, 由 Ollama [32] 服务, 在0 温度下, 所列出的每个文本都位于音符中,无论它作为整词出现在哪里;所发明的或被重新措辞的文本被删除. 在输出限值下再次请求解答为一分之一,如果它仍然无法适应,则无法关闭。 规则过滤器将安全港允许保存的东西放下,无论分配的型号是什么类型:90岁以下、一年、时间或工作日,以及3位数或更小的标识。 同样的年龄规则包住每个堆栈,因为NER模型也标记每个年龄. 即时发布指令和四十个短篇小说并附有答案(约5000个信使;12个信使没有PHI);一位AI助手从虚构的调子半漏的例子中写出这些信使,从不从内容文本中写出;模型的上下文窗口被提升到8,192个信使,因此该快件永远不会被截断. 记录的模型是Gemma 4 26B-A4B [33],是专家的混合体,有约4B活性参数,在Ollama的默认4位分数中. 提示在仓库里

It may veto only spans no known-identifier, pattern or LLM detector reported, and never a location or organization (Results).

blocks.en: Five configurations were fixed on the nursing notes’ tuning half: recall first (known identifiers, patterns, clinical NER, LLM); balanced (the same with the second opinion); balanced, one call (known identifiers, patterns, only the locations and organizations of the clinical NER model, LLM); precision first (known identifiers, patterns, LLM; no NER sidecar); and no LLM (known identifiers, patterns, gazetteer, clinical NER). Stacks with the LLM omit the gazetteer (Results).

blocks.en: 3.2 Corpora
blocks.zh: 3.2 公司

blocks.en: Table 1 summarizes the corpora. The nursing notes are PhysioNet’s Deidentified Medical Text: 2,434 ICU nursing notes from 163 patients, whose PHI was replaced with realistic surrogates, with the gold standard distributed with the deid software [ 34 , 2 , 35 ] . They were deid’s development set, so deid’s default configuration includes lists built from them. The discharge summaries are a semi-synthetic corpus constructed for this study from MIMIC-IV-Note 2.2 [ 36 , 37 ] , whose de-identification replaced each PHI item with “___” and kept no annotation [ 8 ] . Following the “hiding in plain sight” approach [ 38 ] , context rules decide what each placeholder stood for (“Dr. ___” a clinician’s surname, “___ 07:15AM” a date), and a fictional identity per note fills it; each surrogate becomes a gold span. The gold standard is therefore what MIMIC’s own de-identification found. Placeholders that match no rule (41% on the tuning half) are filled with a first name or surname, after a random sample of 100, read in context, showed that every one stood for a name; these are reported as untyped names . The corpus (1,000 patients, one summary each) is drawn by a fixed hash, so any credentialed user rebuilds the identical corpus. ASQ-PHI is a public synthetic benchmark of 1,051 clinical search queries written by GPT-4o, 219 of them hard negatives without PHI [ 26 ] ; its tags carry values, not offsets, so every occurrence of a tagged value in its query is a gold span.

blocks.en: 3.3 Development and use of the reporting halves
blocks.zh: 3.3 报告的编写和使用

blocks.en: Each credentialed corpus is split by patient into a tuning half, on which misses and false positives were read and detectors changed, and a reporting half for published numbers; a patient’s notes fall on one side by a fixed hash of the patient’s number. Detector settings were fixed on the nursing notes’ tuning half; the discharge summaries’ tuning half was used to build that corpus and for later checks of the prompt and model family. Every change was logged as a dated finding with its command, commit and counts, including failed ideas; the log is public, and the commits it names before release 1.0.0 belong to the pre-release development history ( REPRODUCING.md in the repository). Both reporting halves were measured before the final run. The nursing notes’ reporting half was measured five times during development, each time for configurations already fixed on the tuning half, though one of those measurements (the recall the clinical sidecar lost without spaCy’s NER) also informed keeping the gazetteer in the stack without an LLM. The discharge summaries’ reporting half was measured once before the final run; during that measurement the second opinion’s context window was raised to fit long notes, after the results without an LLM had been read and before any result with one. Both halves were measured again for the final run and its sensitivity check, and no setting was changed after a final-run result was read.
blocks.zh: 每份证明书被病人分成调子的一半,其中误读和检测出假阳性,并对公布的数字进行一半报告;病人的笔记被固定的病人数字一散落在一边。 检测器的设置固定在护理笔记上;放出摘要的调取半用于建立这种装置,然后用于检查迅速的模范家庭。 每一次更改都被记录为带有命令、承诺和计数(包括失败的想法)的日期发现;日志是公开的,承诺在发布1.0.0之前的名称属于发布前的发展历史(RepRODUCING.md在寄存器中)。 两次报告的一半是在最后运行前测量的。 护理说明的一半在开发期间被测量了5次,每次都是针对已经固定在调制半上的配置,尽管其中一项测量(在没有SpaCy的NER的情况下丢失的临床侧车的召回)也告知将地名录保存在堆中,没有LLM. 在最后运行之前,对排放摘要的一半进行了一次测量;在进行测量时,第二个意见的上下文窗口被提出来,以适应长时间的注解,在读取了没有LLM的结果之后,再读取任何结果。 两个半径再次被测量到最终运行及其灵敏度检查,在读取最终运行结果后没有改变设置.

blocks.en: The toolkit’s code, tests, documentation and prompt examples were written with an AI coding assistant under the author’s direction (see Use of generative AI). No note text from either credentialed corpus was given to the assistant: it worked only through the evaluation tool, whose output is counts and rates, and misses were read locally, outside the assistant, and described to it with fictional examples. During the study this rested on the assistant’s instructions and the evaluation tool’s counts-only output; a later audit of the assistant’s session logs found no note text, and access to the data is also blocked in its configuration. Every model that processed corpus text, the LLM included, ran on one local workstation.
blocks.zh: 该工具包的代码、测试、文件和即时实例都是由作者指示的AI编码助理撰写的(见基因AI的使用)。 两份证书都没有发给助理人员:它只通过评价工具发挥作用,其产出是计数和费率,误读是在助理人员以外地方读取的,并以虚构的例子加以说明。 在研究期间,这取决于助理的指示和评价工具的计数产出;后来对助理的会话记录进行的审计没有发现注释文本,数据的配置也阻碍了对数据的获取。 每个处理诉讼文书的模型,包括LLM在内,都在一个当地工作站运行。

blocks.en: 3.4 Baselines
blocks.zh: 3.4 基线

blocks.en: Five open tools were run in their default or published configurations, with nothing tuned on these corpora, and scored from files of their predicted spans. deid 1.1 [ 2 ] ran in three configurations: its default, which uses corpus-specific lists built for the nursing notes (surrogate patient names, staff and local-place lists, a ward rule); without those lists; and without them and its hospital list. Philter (philter-ucsf 1.0.3) ran in its default configuration [ 3 ] . Three models ran from weights pinned by commit in an offline container on the GPU: the Stanford/Penn de-identifier [ 9 ] as a standard token-classification pipeline with simple span aggregation (chosen for this study), without the rule-based “hide in plain sight” component its authors combine it with; OpenAI Privacy Filter [ 39 ] through its own package with constrained decoding at the default operating point; and GLiNER multi-PII [ 40 ] at threshold 0.5, asked for the Safe Harbor identifier types in plain words chosen for this study, in windows of 160 words overlapping by 40. To check the scorer, deid’s default output on all 2,434 nursing notes, scored with every label, reproduced its published results exactly (recall 96.68%, 59 spans missed, precision 74.83%; published: 0.967, 59 and 0.749 [ 2 ] ).
blocks.zh: 5个开放工具在其默认或已公布的配置中运行,没有对这些corpora进行调制,并从其预测跨度的文件中得分. deid 1.1 [2] 分为三种配置:默认,它使用为护理笔记(代用病人姓名、工作人员和当地地点名单、病房规则)而制作的具体体格清单;没有这些清单;没有这些清单及其医院名单。 Philter (philter-ucsf 1.0.3) 在其默认配置 [3]. 三种模型来自在GPU一个离线容器中的承诺所固定的重量:斯坦福/Penn去识别器[9]作为标准符号分类管道,具有简单的跨段集合(本研究的选择),其作者没有基于规则的“隐蔽在平地可见”成分与之结合;OpenAI 隐私过滤器[39]通过其自己的包,在默认操作点进行有限制的解码;GLiNER 多-PII[40]在0.5阈值,以本研究所选择的平话要求安全港标识型号,在160个字相接的窗口中输入40个字相接. 为了检查计分器,Deid在所有2,434个护理笔记上的默认输出,每张标签都得分,确切地转载了它公布的结果(回顾96.68%,59个跨度错失,精确度74.83%;发布时间:0.967,59和0.749 [2]).

blocks.en: 3.5 Measures and statistics
blocks.zh: 3.5 措施和统计

blocks.en: The headline measure is span recall : the share of gold spans that any prediction overlaps, whatever category it assigns, since a gold span no prediction touches is leaked PHI. Precision is the share of predicted spans that overlap a gold span. Also reported are character recall (gold characters covered, as in [ 25 ] ), the share of non-PHI text removed (non-whitespace characters outside gold that a prediction covers), word-level F1, and an exact-boundary strict match comparable to the binary evaluation of the 2014 i2b2/UTHealth task [ 5 ] (Supplementary Table S1). The scope is Safe Harbor: a bare year and ages under 90 are not PHI, and a prediction touching only such gold counts as a false positive (a sensitivity analysis counting them neither way is in Supplementary Table S2). Intervals are percentile bootstraps over 1,000 resamples of patients (queries for ASQ-PHI) with a fixed seed [ 41 ] ; a patient’s notes share names and dates, so they are resampled together. The nursing notes’ 163 patients are split between the halves, so their intervals are wide; each discharge summary comes from a different patient. Every stack and baseline in a run is measured on the same resamples, and comparisons use the paired difference’s interval.
blocks.zh: 标题测量是跨度回想:任何预测都重叠的黄金比例,无论它所分配的类别,因为黄金的跨度不漏出任何预测触碰。 精度是预测的相接相接黄金相接的相接相. 还报道了角色召回(覆盖了黄金字符,如[25]),删除了非PHI文本的份额(一个预测所覆盖的黄金以外的非白空字符),字级F1,以及与2014年i2b2/UTHEHE任务[5]的二进制评价相当的精确的严格匹配(补充表S1). 范围为"安全港":光年和90岁以下的年龄不是"PHI",预言只触及到这样的金子,如"假正"(补充表S2中没有计算出它们的灵敏度分析). 间隙是1000多具固定种子的患者复标(ASQ-PHI的克瑞斯)的百分位靴;患者的笔记分享了名字和日期,因此它们被重新标注在一起。 护理笔记中的163名病人被分成一半,所以间隔很宽;每个出院摘要来自不同的病人. 运行中的每个堆栈和基线都在同一复刻上进行测量,比较时使用成对相差的间隔.

blocks.en: 3.6 Prespecified final run
blocks.zh: 3.6 预先确定的最后运行

blocks.en: A protocol fixing the final run’s data, stacks, baselines, measures and four statements was committed to the project repository before any run on a reporting half for that run; the commit (Git tag d6-protocol ) became public together with the results, so its timing rests on the project’s own Git log, not on an external registry. When it was written, the stacks’ earlier reporting-half results and the baselines’ tuning-half results were known, so the statements, especially on the discharge summaries, guarded against a regression more than they tested a new effect. Comparisons with deid, Philter and the other models were not prespecified and are exploratory. The statements compare the stacks with the Stanford/Penn de-identifier, chosen as the model baseline with the highest span recall on both tuning halves and on ASQ-PHI. On each reporting half, statement A : the recall-first stack finds more PHI (paired recall interval above zero); statement B : the precision-first stack loses at most 2 points of recall (paired interval’s lower bound above − 2 -2 , a margin chosen without formal derivation) and has higher precision (paired interval above zero). The four statements are each read from their own 95% interval, without adjustment for multiplicity. Nothing was stated beforehand for ASQ-PHI, where the stacks and the Stanford/Penn model were already near the ceiling in development. One amendment, made after a first pass on ASQ-PHI and the nursing notes had been read, moved the model baselines to a GPU build of the same image and reran every corpus on one commit; the superseded pass gave the same verdicts. Each corpus was then run once, on commit 2059384 (the libraries at version 1.1.0; the archived 1.1.0 release adds publishing safeguards and the sensitivity-check option to the evaluation tool but changes no detector), with the LLM pinned by its Ollama digest and server version (0.40.11), on one workstation (NVIDIA RTX 5080 with 16 GB, Intel Core Ultra 9 285K, 64 GB of memory) with the clinical sidecar on the CPU.
blocks.zh: 确定最后运行的数据、堆栈、基线、措施和4个声明的协议,在对运行进行半个报告运行之前,就已经承诺给项目存储处;承诺(Git tag d6-protocol)随结果一起公开,因此其时间取决于项目本身的Git日志,而不是外部登记册。 当它被写出来时,堆叠的早期报告半结果和基线的调整半结果已经知道,因此,声明,特别是排放摘要上的声明,比试验出新的效果还要防止倒退。 与deid、Philter和其他模型的比较没有预先确定,是探索性的。 报表将堆栈与斯坦福/彭去识别器进行比较,后者被选为模型基线,在调制半音和ASQ-PHI上均具有最高跨度的回溯. 在每报告一半时,报表A:首个堆栈找到更多的PHI(比零更优惠的回放间隔);报表B:精密首个堆栈在最多2个回放点上丢失(比-2-2的回放间隔更低,没有正式引出而选择的比值)并具有更高的精度(比零更优惠的回放间隔). 四个语句各自从自己的95%的间隔读取,不因多相而作调整. 对ASQ-PHI来说,没有事先说明,因为那里堆栈和斯坦福/彭模型已经接近发展的上限。 在首次通过ASQ-PHI和护理笔记之后,对一项修正案进行了修改,将模型基线移到一个具有相同图像的GPU建筑上,并重新列出每项犯罪;被取代的通行证给出了同样的判决。 然后,每套程序被运行一次,在第2059384号承诺(1.1.0版的库;存档的1.1.0版在评价工具中增加了出版保障和敏感度检查选项,但没有改变探测器),LLM以Ollama文摘和服务器版本为主(0.40.11),在一个工作站(NVIDIA RTX 5080有16 GB,Intel Core Ultra 9 285K,64 GB有内存)与CPU上的临床侧车相接.

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Development on the tuning halves
blocks.zh: 4.1 调整工作的发展

blocks.en: Table 2 summarizes the development findings that shaped the stacks. Within Gemma, recall and precision rose with total model size; within Qwen, a 35B mixture of experts with 3B active parameters gained precision but lost recall; Gemma 4 26B-A4B was best on every measure, at about 0.4 s per note. In an ablation, the LLM alone found 95.6% of PHI at 87.6% precision, the clinical NER model alone 87.0% at 58.3%, and their union 98.7%: the NER model’s contribution was mostly locations (it recovered 19 of the 23 places the LLM missed), at a large cost in precision. Pattern detectors added no measurable recall next to the LLM; they remain in every stack because they are deterministic, feed the leak guard, and match the record’s own identifiers. All forty fictional examples gave 10 points more precision than four, at the same speed, and beat examples retrieved per note. A zero-shot prompt found as much PHI as the examples with Gemma on the nursing notes (35 spans missed each) and 0.8 points more on the discharge summaries, at lower precision, so the examples bought precision, not recall. A third family (Ministral 3 14B [ 42 ] ) gained as much recall over the deterministic layer (+70.9 points zero-shot against Gemma’s +70.1) at far lower precision.
blocks.zh: 表2总结了形成堆栈的发展成果。 在Gemma内部,召回和精度随模型总大小而上升;在Quen内部,35B型混合型专家,有3B活性参数,获得精度但失回;Gemma 4 26B-A4B在每分量上最好,每分0.4秒左右. 仅LLM就以87.6%的精度发现了95.6%的PHI,临床NER模型仅以87.0%的精度达到了58.3%,其结合率为98.7%:NER模型的贡献大多是位置(在LLM错过的23个位置中恢复了19个),其精度成本很高. 模式探测器没有在LLM旁边添加任何可测量的回想;它们留在了每一堆堆中,因为它们具有决定力,为漏出后卫提供食物,并与记录本身的识别器相匹配. 所有40个虚构的例子都给出了比4个更精确的10分,速度相同,并且比每个音符所检索到的例子要快. 一个0发快取找到的PHI和护理笔记上与Gemma的示例一样多(每张间隔35个),放出摘要上多出0.8分,精度更低,所以这些示例购买了精度,没有回忆. 第三个家族(Ministry 3 14B [42])以更低的精度在决定地层(+70.9分零射出Gemma的+70.1)上获得同样多的回想.

blocks.en: The second opinion raised precision by 18.7 points when allowed to judge every span from the clinical model, but rejected real hospital and unit names; barred from locations and organizations, it cost 2 spans ( − 0.24 -0.24 pp, − 0.57 -0.57 to 0.00) for +11.9 points of precision. Allowed to judge the LLM’s own findings as well, the same model discarded 24.6 points of recall ( − 29.5 -29.5 to − 19.8 -19.8 ) for +3.3 points of precision.
blocks.zh: 第二种意见将精确度提高了18.7分,允许从临床模型中判断每个跨度,但否定了真正的医院和单位名称;禁止进入地点和组织,其成本为2分(0.24-0.24页;0.57-0.57-0.00),用于+11.9分的精确度。 为了判断LLM本身的调查结果,同一模型也放弃了24.6分(-29.5-29.5至-19.8-19.8分),用于+3.3分的精确度。

blocks.en: Table 2: Selected development findings on the nursing notes’ tuning half (844 gold spans). Recall is span recall, with its 95% interval where it decided a choice. “Det.” is the known-identifier and pattern detectors; LLM is gemma4:26b-a4b unless named.
blocks.zh: 表2:护理说明调整半(844个黄金跨度)的部分发展结果。 召回是跨度召回,在它决定选择的时间间隔为95%。 “Det”是已知的识别器和图案探测器;LLM是gemma4:26b-a4b,除非被命名。

blocks.en: 4.2 Final run
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 最终运行

blocks.en: Table 3 gives the final run, Figure 2 its paired comparisons, and Table 4 the prespecified statements, all of which held. On the nursing notes, the recall-first stack missed 10 of 889 gold spans, against 35 for Stanford/Penn and 24 for deid with its corpus-specific lists, and paid 9.3 points of precision relative to Stanford/Penn ( − 12.6 -12.6 to − 5.5 -5.5 ). The precision-first stack, with no NER sidecar, matched Stanford/Penn’s recall (+0.45, − 1.45 -1.45 to 2.54) at 19.6 points more precision. On the discharge summaries, both stacks led Stanford/Penn by more than 20 points of recall. That margin came from the untyped names (12,632 spans, 44% of gold), of which Stanford/Penn found 40.7% and the recall-first and precision-first stacks 89.2% and 86.6%; on the typed labels, they found 99.3%, 99.96% and 99.7%. The LLM alone, an ablation measured in earlier runs, is in Supplementary Table S5.
blocks.zh: 表3列出最后运行情况,图2为对应比较,表4为预留的报表,所有报表均持有。 在护理说明中,第一组漏掉了889个金字节中的10个,斯坦福/彭州为35个,其实体清单为24个,与斯坦福/彭州相比,支付了9.3个精准点(-12.6-12.6至-5.5-5.5)。 精度第一堆没有NER侧车,与斯坦福/彭恩的召回(+0.45,−1.45-1.45至2.54)在19.6分更精确. 在放出摘要上,两堆都使斯坦福/彭恩召回了20多分. 这一比值来自未打出的名称(12,632个跨度,为黄金的44%),其中斯坦福/彭恩发现40.7%,召回第一和精密第一堆89.2%和86.6%;在打入的标签上,他们发现99.3%,99.96%和99.7%. 单是LLM,按先前的计算,在补充表S5中。

blocks.zh: 表4:预先指定的语句,每段语句与斯坦福/彭去识别符的对比(分分百分点,对接95%的靴子间隔). 报表B有两个条件。

blocks.en: 4.3 Exploratory comparisons
blocks.zh: 4.3 探索性比较

blocks.en: On ASQ-PHI, no stack with the LLM differed significantly from Stanford/Penn in recall (recall-first +0.07, 0.00 to 0.17), and the precision-first stack had 1.86 points more precision (1.39 to 2.39). On the nursing notes, deid’s home corpus, no configuration found significantly more PHI than deid with its corpus-specific lists: the recall-first stack’s lead (+1.57 points) had a paired interval starting at zero (0.00 to 3.27), and the precision-first stack’s recall did not differ significantly ( − 0.79 -0.79 , − 2.80 -2.80 to 1.27) at 10.6 points more precision (6.8 to 14.9). Against deid without those lists, the recall-first and balanced stacks found more (+2.81, 1.04 to 4.80; +2.14, 0.33 to 4.04). Without an LLM, the toolkit trailed deid by 9 points of recall. On the nursing notes, whose gold standard follows deid’s conventions, deid also had the highest strict (exact-boundary) F1 (Supplementary Table S1). On the discharge summaries, every stack with the LLM found more than deid in any configuration (recall-first +3.20, 2.74 to 3.68, at equal precision; precision-first +1.92, 1.40 to 2.45, with 3.5 points more precision). Much of that lead is the generator’s fictional hospitals and cities, which deid’s lists rarely match; without them, the leads shrink to about 1.5 and 0.2 points (unpaired). Philter touched more gold spans on the discharge summaries (99.4%) but covered fewer PHI characters (83.3% against 96.0–97.1%), removed three to four times as much other text, and had 23 to 27 points less precision.
blocks.zh: 在ASQ-PHI上,与LLM没有堆栈在召回时与斯坦福/彭恩大相径庭(回顾第一+0.07,0.00到0.17),而精度第一堆有1.86分更精度(1.39到2.39分). 在护理笔记上,Deid的家用书中,没有发现任何配置PHI明显多于其具体体表的Deid:回溯第一堆铅(+1.57分)的对接间隔从0起(0.00至3.27分),而精密第一堆的回溯没有显著差异(-0.79至0.79分,-2.80至2.80至1.27分),在10.6分更精确(6.8至14.9分). 在没有这些清单的情况下,首发和平衡的堆栈发现更多(+2.81、1.04至4.80;+2.14、0.33至4.04)。 没有LLM,这个工具箱就被9分的召回。 护理笔记上,其金本位跟随戴德的惯例,戴德也有最严格的(精确的边界)F1(补充表S1)。 在放出摘要上,每个与LLM相接的堆栈在任何配置中都发现比去除多(回溯-first+3.20,2.74至3.68,等分精度;精度-first+1.92,1.40至2.45,等分精度为3.5分). 这些线索大多是发电机的虚构医院和城市,而代德公司的名单很少匹配;没有这些线索,线索就缩到1.5分和0.2分左右(未标出). 菲尔特在排放摘要上接触了更多的黄金(99.4%),但涵盖的PHI字符较少(83.3%,96.0–97.1%),删除了3至4倍于其他文本,并且有23至27分的精度更低.

blocks.en: 4.4 Reproduction, sensitivity and runtime
blocks.zh: 4.4 复制、敏感性和运行时间

blocks.en: The final run reproduced earlier measurements made at other commits: exactly on the discharge summaries, to within 0.01 point on ASQ-PHI, and to within one span on the nursing notes. Three consecutive runs had given identical spans on the nursing notes and ASQ-PHI; the discharge summaries’ LLM stacks ran once. Counting out-of-scope gold neither for nor against any tool left recall unchanged, moved precision by at most 1.2 points, and changed no verdict (Supplementary Table S2). The LLM took 0.4 s per nursing note and 7.5 s per discharge summary, with a fifth of the 17.9 GB model in CPU memory; the full run took 24 minutes each for the nursing notes and ASQ-PHI and 2 hours 14 minutes for the discharge summaries.
blocks.zh: 最终运行重复了以前在其他场合进行的测量:完全在排放摘要上,在ASQ-PHI0.01分以内,在护理笔记上。 连续3次运行都给护理笔记和ASQ-PHI提供了相同的间隔;排出简表的LLM堆积一次. 计算范围外的黄金既不是用于也不用于任何遗留工具的召回,精确度最高为1.2分,没有改变判断(补充表S2)。 LLM每张护理笔记取了0.4 s,每张放出摘要取了7.5 s,其中CPU内存为17.9 GB模型的五分之一;全跑为护理笔记和ASQ-PHI各取了24分,放出摘要取了2小时14分.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: 5.1 Principal findings
blocks.zh: 5.1 主要调查结果

blocks.en: Under a prespecified protocol, the recall-first stack found more PHI than the strongest open clinical model on both reporting halves, and the precision-first stack, without NER, matched it on the nursing notes and exceeded it on the discharge summaries, with higher precision on both. The discharge-summary margins come from the corpus’s generated untyped names; on typed labels Stanford/Penn and both stacks found more than 99%. In the ablations, the LLM was the main detector; the clinical NER model, trained with i2b2’s hospital label, added place names; and patterns added little. Because the two models fail differently, their union beat either one.
blocks.zh: 在预先规定的协议下,召回第一堆发现的PHI比最强的开放临床模型在报告分出一半,而精密第一堆在没有NER的情况下,在护理笔记上与它相匹配,并在放出摘要上超过了它,两者的精度都更高. 排出量的比值来自该实体生成的无型号名称;在打入的标签上,斯坦福/彭和两个堆都发现超过99%。 在血清中,LLM是主要的探测器;临床NER模型经过了i2b2医院标签的培训,增加了地名;而图案几乎没有增加. 因为两个模特的失败程度不同,所以他们的工会会击败任何一个.

blocks.en: Three results bear on how LLMs should be used for de-identification. First, the prompt’s fictional examples and the model’s family decided precision more than recall: a zero-shot prompt found as much PHI, and a third family gained as much recall over the deterministic layer at far lower precision; within Gemma, a model with more total parameters raised both. Second, a model is a poor judge of its own findings: asked to list PHI, it found it; asked to verify the same spans as candidates, it discarded a quarter of the true PHI. Verification helped only when confined to another detector’s spans and barred from places. Third, a Census gazetteer worth about 3 points of recall without an LLM added 2 or 3 spans next to one, at a large cost in precision; local site lists, such as deid’s hospital list (11 points on its home corpus), were not tested next to an LLM.
blocks.zh: 三个结果涉及如何利用有限责任管理办法去除识别。 首先,当机的虚构例子和模型的家族比回忆更精确地决定了:一个零镜头的快取找到同样多的PHI,第三个家族以更低的精度在决定性的地层上获得了同样多的回想;在Gemma内部,一个具有更全面参数的模型同时提出了两者。 其次,一个模型是对自己的调查结果判断不力的:它被要求列出PHI,它找到了它;它被要求核实与候选人相同的跨度,它抛弃了四分之一真实的PHI. 核查只有在限制在另一探测器的跨度和禁止进入的地方时才有帮助。 第三,一个普查地名录,价值约3分,但没有一个LLM,旁边加了2个或3个跨度,费用很高,精确度很高;当地地点清单,如Deid的医院清单(11分在其家庭目录上),没有在LLM旁边测试。

blocks.en: 5.2 Comparison with prior work
blocks.zh: 5.2 与以往工作的比较

blocks.en: Zhou et al. also found that adding an LLM to the same RoBERTa model reduced false negatives, though it lowered entity-level F1 on i2b2; their LLM verified the NER model’s spans, the role in which verification helped here too [ 24 ] . Larger local models also de-identified better in other work [ 19 ] , and multi-pass and auditor designs did not beat a single pass [ 16 ] . On ASQ-PHI, MedDeID’s own model reached a character recall of 98.9%, above the DeidSharp stacks’ 97.7% to 97.9%; its comparator scores are not directly comparable with those here, since it post-processed their spans and configured some differently [ 25 ] .
blocks.zh: 周来等. 还发现,在同一个RoBERTa模型中添加一个LLM会减少假负数,虽然它降低了i2b2上的实体级F1;他们的LLM验证了NER模型的跨度,而核查在这方面也起到了帮助的作用[24]. 更大的本地模型在其他作品中也解析得更好[19],多通和审计设计没有击败一通[16]. 在ASQ-PHI上,MedDeID自己的模式达到了98.9%的字符召回率,高于DeidSharp 堆栈的97.7%到97.9%;其比较器的分数与这里的分数不直接相上下,因为它在经过处理后对分数进行了处理,并做了一些不同的配置 [25] 。

blocks.en: These comparisons need qualifying. The baselines ran untuned and out of domain, while DeidSharp’s prompt examples were written after the tuning half’s misses had been read; Stanford/Penn ran without the rule-based component its authors pair it with; and no published LLM-based de-identifier was a baseline. The rule-based tools held their ground: deid matched every stack on its home corpus, and Philter found more discharge-summary spans at far lower precision. Results also varied by corpus: Stanford/Penn matched the precision-first stack on nursing notes and synthetic queries but found 41% of untyped names in discharge summaries, and ASQ-PHI, where the stacks, Stanford/Penn and GLiNER all exceeded 99% recall, separated the tools less than the clinical corpora did.
blocks.zh: 这些比较需要限定。 基线没有调整,而且没有域名,而DeidSharp的即时示例是在读取了调取误差的一半之后编写的;Stanford/Penn运行时没有基于规则的组件,其作者将其配对;没有出版的基于LLM的去识别器是一个基线。 以规则为基础的工具坚守了自己的地盘:Deid符合其主体上的每一堆,而菲尔特以更低的精度发现了更多的放出-总结跨度. 调查的结果也各不相同:斯坦福/Penn与护理笔记和合成查询的精密第一堆匹配,但在排出量摘要中发现了41%的无型名称,而ASQ-PHI则将堆、斯坦福/Penn和GLinner都超过了99%的召回量,将工具分离得比临床公司少。

blocks.en: 5.3 Implications for practice
blocks.zh: 5.3 对实践的影响

blocks.en: Each stack suits a different setting. Without a GPU, the stack without an LLM (its NER sidecar on a CPU) found 88% of the nursing notes’ PHI at 43% precision. With one 16 GB GPU and no sidecar, the precision-first stack found 96.5% and removed 0.15% of the other text. Where recall must come first, the recall-first stack missed 10 of 889 spans at 54% precision, and the balanced stacks sit between the two. Whichever is chosen, recall should be measured on a sample of the site’s own notes.
blocks.zh: 每个堆栈适合不同的设置. 没有GPU,没有LLM(它在CPU上的NER侧车)的堆栈以43%的精度发现了88%的护理笔记的PHI. 以一款16GB GPU而无侧式车厢,精密第一堆找到了96.5%并去掉了0.15%的其他文本. 在必须首先召回的地方,召回的第一堆错失了889个中的10个,精度为54%,平衡堆坐落在两者之间. 无论选择哪一个,都应根据网站本身的纸币样本来衡量召回情况。

blocks.en: 5.4 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5.4 限制

blocks.en: Both credentialed corpora come from one hospital (Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center) through MIMIC, and both carry surrogate rather than original PHI. The discharge summaries are semi-synthetic: their gold standard is what MIMIC’s de-identification found; their surrogates come from rules written for this study, with names from the gazetteer’s lists and places on no real list; 44% of the reporting half’s gold spans are untyped names, a label based on a sample of 100 (by the rule of three, up to 3% may stand for something else); one identity per note and reused clinicians’ names favor detectors that find repeated mentions; and generated surrogates may be more regular than real PHI. The nursing notes’ gold standard was built partly with deid’s prototype, and gold standards miss PHI [ 16 ] ; false positives were not reviewed by hand, so some may be PHI the gold missed. ASQ-PHI’s queries were generated by an LLM and are public, and the open deid package publishes the nursing notes’ PHI terms and deid’s scrubbed output of every note, so a model trained on web data may have seen either corpus. The i2b2/n2c2 corpora, on which most prior work reports, were not open to new registration.
blocks.zh: 两者都通过MIMIC从一家医院(Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center)获得证书,两者都携带代孕而不是原型PHI. 排出摘要是半合成的:他们的金本位是MIMIC的去识别发现的;他们的代名词来自为本研究而写出的规则,地名表上的名字和没有真实的列表;44%的报告半个黄金跨度是无型名称,一个基于100个样本的标签(按照3个规则,最多3 % 可能代表别的东西);每个音符一个身份和重复使用的临床医生的名字倾向于发现重复引用的探测器;生成的代名词可能比真实的PHI更常态. 护理笔记的金本位部分是用Deid的原型来构建的,而金本位错失了PHI [16];假阳性没有通过手审查,因此有些可能是PHI丢失了金本位. ASQ-PHI的询问由LLM生成, PHI名词和Deid的每个音符的擦拭输出,因此一个受过网络数据培训的模型可能已经看到这两种音符。 i2b2/n2c2 corpora是大多数以前的工作报告,没有向新的登记开放。

blocks.en: The reporting halves were measured during development, and the final run’s protocol is self-attested and was written knowing earlier results (Methods). Recall counts any overlap as found, which is lenient next to strict matching (reported in the supplement) and to document-level “all-or-nothing” recall [ 43 ] , which was not reported. A known gazetteer fault, which affects only the stack without an LLM, was left unfixed so that the run measured the code the protocol fixed. The leak guard and the known-identifier detector were not evaluated.
blocks.zh: 报告的一半是在开发期间测量的,最后运行的程序是自我测试的,并且是写成的,知道早先的结果(方法)。 回顾已发现的任何重叠都算在内,这种重叠在严格匹配(在补编中报告)和在文件一级“全部或一无所有”之后是宽松的,没有报告。 一个已知的地名录断层,它只影响没有 LLM 的堆栈,它没有被固定,这样运行会测量协议所固定的代码. 漏出后卫和已知识别器探测器没有被评估.

blocks.en: The final run used one LLM and one server version, and another may change spans slightly; only two other model families were tried, on tuning halves. A Stanford/Penn successor that adds ages [ 44 ] was not evaluated, and the tools’ overlapping spans, unlike DeidSharp’s stacks’, were scored unmerged, which slightly affects GLiNER’s precision. Finally, the measured stacks need a 16 GB GPU and, for the recall-first stack, a Docker sidecar; no stack is a substitute for local validation and governance.
blocks.zh: 最终运行使用了一个LLM和一个服务器版本,而另一个版本可能稍有变化;只有另外两个模型家族被尝试过,在调取半音. 一个增加年龄[44]的斯坦福/彭后继者没有被评价,而且与DeidSharp的堆栈不同的是,这些工具的重叠跨度没有被打出,这略微影响了GLinER的精度. 最后,所测量的堆栈需要16GB GPU,对于召回的第一堆,需要多克的侧车;没有堆栈可以代替本地的验证和治理.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: A local LLM layered with deterministic detectors and a clinical NER model gave recall-first and precision-first operating points that, under a prespecified protocol, found more PHI than an open clinical de-identifier on two reporting halves (the precision-first stack matched it on one, with higher precision), largely on names a trained model missed, without sending text off-site. On deid’s home corpus they matched rather than surpassed a rule-based tool built for it. The toolkit, the evaluation tool, every finding including negative ones, and the commands to rerun them are public.
blocks.zh: 本地的LLM分层有测定探测器和临床NER模型,给出了回溯第一和精度第一的操作点,根据预先指定的协议,在两次报告上发现的PHI比公开的临床去识别器要多(精度第一堆与它相匹配,精度更高),主要指一个训练有素的模型丢失的名字,而没有将文字发出场外. 在Deid的家保中,他们比比而不是超过为它设计的有章可循的工具。 工具包,评价工具,每个发现,包括负面发现,以及重新运行的命令都是公开的.

blocks.en: Ethics statement

blocks.en: This study is a secondary analysis of de-identified data, used under PhysioNet’s credentialed data use agreements and within the approvals and consent waivers granted for the source databases by their Institutional Review Boards.
